method: ConvNeXt-Tiny fine-tune exactly as E6b; only input resolution changes 128 -> 224
explanation: Val accuracy 0.976 / macro precision 0.979: +1.7 pts over E6b with ONLY resolution changed (128 -> 224). Biggest gains on the classes whose files are natively 240 px: facebook 0.91 -> 0.97, whatsapp 0.94 -> 0.97 - downsampling to 128 was destroying discriminative detail. Cost: ~3x compute per epoch (2h10 on Apple M4 MPS vs 18 min).
preprocessing: Alpha-composite on white background, then resize to 224 x 224 (bicubic), ImageNet normalisation
preprocessing_why: 224 px is ConvNeXt's pre-training resolution and close to the native 240 px of Facebook/Messenger/Mozilla files, so fine stroke and shading details are preserved instead of being downsampled.
